consequence.statement: Traefik will fail to start if the Consul provider `namespace` option is set.

original.statement: The Consul provider's `namespace` configuration option, deprecated in v2, is removed in v3 and unsupported; Traefik will fail to start if it is set.

decision.reason: [ev-3ab5da393af7] says the Consul provider `namespace` option is removed in v3, "is now unsupported and would prevent Traefik to start". A v3 Traefik that cannot start while the old option is still set is an unmet precondition that blocks the upgrade. That makes upgrade-blocked the right kind, and action-required the right class. Critical severity also fits, because the proxy does not come up at all.
